description: This class includes mining of hard coal: underground or open-cast mining, cleaning, sizing, grading, pulverizing, compressing (e.g. briquetting) and other non-agglomeration processes to improve quality or facilitate transport or storage of coal.
includes: mining of hard coal: underground and open-cast mining
cleaning, sizing, grading, pulverizing, compressing of hard coal
recovery of hard coal from culm banks
excludes: support activities for coal mining, see 0990
manufacture of coke oven products, see 1910
